qr.description: QR menu turned on by the owner

auth.description: Ways a customer can confirm a phone number. A hint to hide dead buttons; the endpoints stay the source of truth

modes.description: Empty unless channels.delivery.published. pickup: an active branch accepts pickup. delivery: an active branch accepts delivery and a delivery zone is set. Empty without branches

defaultMode.description: First of modes; null when modes is empty

deliveryOffered.description: An active branch accepts delivery. false = the venue has no delivery by choice (hide the delivery tab); independent of publication and the zone

deliveryAvailable.description: Delivery can be ordered right now: modes contains delivery

deliveryUnavailableReason.description: null when deliveryAvailable. not_offered: no active branch takes delivery; channel_disabled: the owner turned ordering off; not_published: not published or paused; no_zone: the delivery zone is not set. The first that applies, in this order

center.description: [lat, lng]. The saved view; without one, the middle of the delivery zone, else of the branches. null only when the venue has no zone and no branch with coordinates

centerSource.description: Where center comes from: saved (owner), zone (delivery zone bounding box), branches (branch coordinates); null when center is null

zoom.description: Saved zoom; without one a computed zoom fitting the zone or branches (10-17) when center is computed; null for a saved center without a zoom

deliveryZone.description: Delivery polygon [[lat, lng], ...]; null = delivery unavailable

primaryDomain.description: The venue's earliest verified own domain (bare host, no scheme), or null; the platform address {slug}.PLATFORM_DOMAIN always works

description.description: In the response language, else the venue's default language, else null

theme.description: Brand colors over the platform neutral colors: always all 9 keys, never null. Front-ends keep no neutral values of their own

host.description: Canonical host: ASCII (IDN as punycode), lower case

isPrimary.description: This is primaryDomain: the earliest verified domain of the venue

lastCheckError.description: Why the last check failed; null after a successful one

verification.description: DNS record that proves ownership; keep it after verification

platformHost.description: The platform address {slug}.PLATFORM_DOMAIN (always works, needs no row); null without a slug or PLATFORM_DOMAIN

primaryDomain.description: Earliest verified own domain, or null

limit.description: Domains a venue may have, pending ones included

host.description: Bare host name: no scheme, path or port. Case, a trailing dot and IDN (ресторан.uz) are normalised. Not the platform domain or anything under it, not localhost, .local, .internal or an IP
